result.quote: Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
result.reason: Verse 9:31 directly and uniquely supports the key. The wording clearly asks for the content of Zebul’s warning. However, the edit changes the original target from why Zebul sent the messengers to the fuller content of the warning, adding that Gaal’s brothers had come to Shechem.
